original_messages.content: Summarize the history of OpenAI in three sentences.

answer: OpenAI was founded in December 2015 by Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, Ilya Sutskever, and other leaders with the mission of building safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence. In 2019 it shifted to a capped‑profit model, attracting investment from Microsoft and other partners, and launched influential models such as GPT‑3 and GPT‑4. The organization has experienced significant leadership changes, including the brief ousting and reinstatement of CEO Sam Altman in late 2023, while continuing to advance AI research and deployment.
